steps.clue: Use Brutus to open the Warden’s Ritual Chamber.
Activate the electric chair and place the red stone in Richtofen’s Lab to release the Spectral Bird.
Track the Spectral Bird and Spirit Blast it over three rounds.
Use Zombie Blood and the Hell’s Retriever to recover the Kronorium from the final bird.
Place the Kronorium in the Ritual Chamber and use its codes to direct the lighthouse.
Complete the five lighthouse trials and collect their red stones.
Place the five stones in Richtofen’s map, then confront the Warden in the Ritual Chamber.
Escape the prison cells, follow the Spectral Bird and recover the final red stone.
Place the final stone in Richtofen’s map and enter the Dark Mechanism chamber.
Destroy the Warden’s spectral orbs, charge the Dark Mechanism and sacrifice Richtofen.
